QUOTE: "| code | server loaded old logic; reads are fine, writes are affected | restart the MCP client; rebuild cannot fix it |" alongside "| data | N source files changed... | `index(action='refresh')` |"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the data axis is cleared by a refresh and the code axis only by a client restart, since a rebuild cannot fix it. It never says outright that one flag would not have been enough, but the point that each axis needs a different action is there.
